purpose: Track residual risks, known limitations and non-promotable claims in the Mega Drive AAA video curation package.
risk_policy: A risk is not resolved by adding more prose.
A risk is resolved only by the evidence listed in its required_resolution_evidence field.
Any unresolved critical risk blocks promotion to validated_curation.
Runtime, ROM, visual and AAA release risks are outside this package unless project evidence exists.

risks.description: An earlier Codex runner could not start local processes and returned CreateProcessAsUserW failed: 5; this no longer reproduces and validate_aaa_video_curation.ps1 now prints PASSED. Retained as a historical risk because the runner environment can regress.
risks.impact: While active, the validator, workspace audits, git status, commit and push could not be proven; a regression would reintroduce the same impact.
required_resolution_evidence: workspace audits execute or blockers are recorded
git commands produce real output before commit/push claims

risks.description: The broader 64-video corpus is known only through another agent's aggregate analysis.
risks.impact: The package can use the aggregate as backlog pressure but cannot claim individual source verification.
required_resolution_evidence: direct curation records for promoted cases

risks.description: Eleven existing skill/workflow updates were applied as sidecar handoffs instead of direct SKILL.md rewrites to avoid unsafe overwrites while shell/file inspection is blocked.
risks.impact: Agents must load sidecars or the updates may be missed by tools that only read SKILL.md bodies.
required_resolution_evidence: manual or automated review of original SKILL.md files
validator adjusted to check final integration mode

risks.description: Even a future PASS from validate_aaa_video_curation validates package coherence only.
risks.impact: Agents could confuse curation-package validation with ROM, runtime, visual, budget or AAA release validation.
required_resolution_evidence: BlastEm/emulator evidence when runtime is claimed

risks.description: The package inventory declares expected counts that must be updated whenever mandatory artifacts are added or removed.
risks.impact: If counts drift, validators and documentation can contradict each other.
required_resolution_evidence: inventory updated with every mandatory artifact change

risks.description: The twenty new skills and related workflows have been written but not validated by local tooling.
risks.impact: They improve curation structure but must not be represented as fully validated canonical runtime practice.

risks.description: Operational memory was captured in a curation capsule but not merged into the primary workspace memory bank while local inspection/execution is blocked.
risks.impact: Future agents must load the capsule or they may miss key decisions, load order and pending recovery actions.
required_resolution_evidence: primary workspace memory bank safely inspected
current capsule decisions reviewed for freshness
approved decisions merged or explicitly deferred
